name: qa_inserts
title: OS-INSFX S1 and S2, Inserts from the console: an effect module (kind 2) bound to a track insert with `diag ins`, heard, measured (`ins`, `cpu`), bypassed, reset and unbound while the transport plays. S3b: a console bind, unbind and bypass are written to the project (INSX): the last steps save, reset and check that a load binds them again (QA-GLB-173). Needs an effect module file on the card: modules/effects/example_effect.tmod (the SDK template, built by the tester). Writes the card only at the QA-GLB-173 save (the scratch project's folder). Leaves no insert bound

steps.say: OS-INSFX S1, rows QA-GLB-161..167 of docs/qa/catalogue/global.md (a unit step is named by the row id its note begins with). Open the project the run is about (the Dense8 song of OS-DENSE, or any project with a sounding track 1) before the run, and put modules/effects/example_effect.tmod on the card. The insert is console-bound: it is lost on save and on reload until the project record lands (slice S3); `ins` says nothing about saving

steps.note: (Shift released, in case a former run left it down)
QA-GLB-161: the totals line with no insert bound: no insert line follows
the effect module is loaded (the kind is not shown: `ins bind` refuses an instrument)
QA-GLB-162: an effect module bound to track 1, slot 1 (the activation is applied at the next block boundary)

steps.expect: ins: bind an insert is bound there already
steps.note: QA-GLB-162: the same place twice is refused
QA-GLB-163: the insert is running (phase on); its measured cycles and share of the block are on the line
QA-GLB-163: the load with the insert on; the insert's cycles are inside the render figure (the governor's base)
QA-GLB-163: the totals line again: nothing was forced to dry
QA-GLB-164: bypass is a one-block ramp to the dry signal, no click
QA-GLB-164
QA-GLB-164: off is a reset of the effect (shutdown, init, its parameters) through the swap protocol: the module's tail starts again from silence
QA-GLB-164

QA-GLB-167: `tail` is also shown while the source is live (the effect returns 1); right after the stop it still reads `tail` (with example_effect until its output has been exactly 0 for 2 s of silent source; a feedback effect would ring for its own time)
QA-GLB-167: 5 s later (the release plus the 2 s zero rule) there is no `tail` word: the strip is idle again
QA-GLB-167: the render figure is a stopped transport's, with the insert bound and idle (nothing of the insert is run)
QA-GLB-165: unbind is a one-block ramp to dry, then the module is shut down once the render is clear of it

steps.expect: ins: unbind no insert bound there
steps.note: QA-GLB-165
QA-GLB-165: the counters: retired 1 or more, params and stale in the totals line
QA-GLB-165: underruns 0 over the run (read it against the first read)

expect: BENCH insert \d+ 64 avg \d+ max \d+ \(.*, adapter \d+ cycles \(\d+\.\d%\) peak \d+\)
steps.note: QA-GLB-166: bench image, transport stopped, example_effect still loaded: the adapter's cost is the number after `adapter` (insert minus insert_effect)

steps.say: OS-INSFX S3b, row QA-GLB-173 (and QA-FIL-138): inserts are saved with the project and bound again when it loads. Use a SCRATCH project of your own (a copy such as Projects/t-v16-copy, never the original), open on the unit with modules/effects/example_effect.tmod on the card. Below: bind two inserts (one bypassed), save with the File screen, reset the unit, and check that the unit's own project open after boot brings both back. The save writes the project folder on the card.

steps.note: QA-GLB-173: the scratch project the S3b steps change and save: Projects/t-v16-copy (loaded here, so the binds below are written to a project that is open; never the original Projects/t-v16)
(a former run's insert, if any, is removed: `no insert bound there` is also fine)
(the same)
the effect module is loaded
QA-GLB-173: track 1 slot 1 (written to the project: the project is now changed)
QA-GLB-173: track 2 slot 2
QA-GLB-173: the second one is bypassed (the flag is written to the project)
QA-GLB-173: both are bound before the save; the second reads `bypassed, bypass`

steps.say: QA-GLB-173 BY HAND: SAVE the project on the File screen (the strip says it is saved; wait for it to finish). Then POWER-CYCLE THE UNIT (a scenario may not send `reset`): the project open at power-on (OS-BOOTLAST) is the one just saved. Load the same project instead if the unit does not reopen the last one: `load Projects/<its folder>`.
QA-GLB-173: after the power cycle wait for the Pattern screen and for the project to open (the strip says PROJECT ... OPENED), then continue.

steps.note: QA-GLB-173: after the boot both inserts are bound again by the project load (no `mod load` or `ins bind` was typed), module example_effect, and the second is still bypassed

steps.say: QA-GLB-173 BY HAND: the boot log of that start has the binder line `modules: ... inserts: 2, 2 bound, 0 skipped` (`sd` prints only the project load summary, not this line). QA-GLB-173 BY HAND, the previous firmware: put a build from before S3a on the same card and open the same project: it plays without the inserts and opens normally; save it there; open it again in this build: both inserts are back (the older build keeps the chunk byte for byte).

steps.note: QA-GLB-173: cleanup, the project record goes too (do not save it again if the inserts are meant to stay)
QA-GLB-173: cleanup
